subject: Fix xpad controller not detected on cold boot (config: m → y) (#108)
author: ssxpatrick

upstream.vanilla_quote:
config JOYSTICK_XPAD
	tristate "Xbox gamepad support"
	depends on USB_ARCH_HAS_HCD
	select USB

provenance_doc_ref: Reverses docs/patch-provenance.md Q10 (2026-07-15), which switched our CONFIG_JOYSTICK_XPAD from =y to =m to match the fork-HEAD MiSTer_defconfig of the day. Stock has now moved back to =y and we follow it.

impact.effect_if_absent: With xpad as a module it binds roughly 2 s after USB enumeration, which on a cold boot or reboot lands after Main_MiSTer's start-up input scan; per MiSTer-devel/Main_MiSTer#1324 an already-plugged 8BitDo Pro 2 Wired (and, by the same mechanism, any pad xpad drives) is not recognised until it is unplugged and replugged. Regression on stock since Release 20260907; on our image since Q10 (2026-07-15). Not reproduced on our image -- hardware test owed.
affected_hardware: any USB pad driven by xpad that is plugged in at boot (Xbox / Xbox 360 / Xbox One wired pads and the third-party pads in xpad_device[], e.g. 8BitDo Pro 2 Wired)

userspace_coupling.interface: timing of the /dev/input/eventN node appearing relative to Main_MiSTer's start-up input scan

forward_port.effort: low -- one config line, mirrored in board/mister/de10nano/linux.config and board/mister/common/linux-mister.fragment

superseded_by: board/mister/de10nano/linux.config:373 CONFIG_JOYSTICK_XPAD=y (both DE10 kernels: the stock-track kernel and linux-rt read this file)
board/mister/common/linux-mister.fragment:445 CONFIG_JOYSTICK_XPAD=y (DE25; the fragment must stay a no-op on the DE10's resolved config)

notes:
ACTED ON, same shape as 5fcfae369 (CONFIG_TUN): our kernel config is a linux.config rather than an arch/arm/configs defconfig, so the fork's hunk is dropped and the symbol is mirrored as a config line. 'dropped-deliberate' follows the rule that 'carried' strictly means a 00xx-*.patch exists.

VERIFIED AGAINST THE REAL PINS. DE10: linux.config before/after through `make ARCH=arm olddefconfig` on pristine linux-6.18.55 with all 53 linux-patches applied at -F0; the resolved configs differ in exactly one line (CONFIG_JOYSTICK_XPAD=m -> =y). Its companions already resolve built-in: CONFIG_USB=y, CONFIG_LEDS_CLASS=y (JOYSTICK_XPAD_LEDS needs LEDS_CLASS=y once xpad is =y), CONFIG_INPUT_FF_MEMLESS=y. zImage + modules built with the Buildroot cross toolchain: xpad appears in modules.builtin, no xpad.ko is produced, no new warnings. Every line of linux-mister.fragment is still present verbatim in the DE10's resolved config (the fragment's no-op invariant). DE25: merge_config.sh of board/mister/de25nano/linux.config + the fragment, then `make ARCH=arm64 olddefconfig` on linux-7.2.9 with the de25nano series applied; again exactly one line differs, with JOYSTICK_XPAD_FF and JOYSTICK_XPAD_LEDS still =y.

MODULE PARAMETERS STILL WORK. u-boot.txt's documented knob `xpad.cpoll=1` (docs/boot-chain.md) is a kernel command-line parameter, which a built-in driver reads directly.

NOT TESTED ON HARDWARE: the cold-boot detection improvement is the upstream reporter's claim (Main_MiSTer#1324, closed); our image was not booted with this change.
